Annalakshmi is a vegetarian restaurant in Chennai, India, with
additional restaurants in three other countries. There are no prices on
the menu, so guests pay what they can! The people who work there
are volunteers and take turns serving customers, cleaning tables, and
washing dishes. Indian art covers the walls, and there are even live
music and dance performances. OQ Zaikes

At Dans Le Noir (in the Dark) in Paris, guests order their food in a place
with a lot of light, but then they eat in darkness. They focus on the
touch, smell, and taste of the food. The waiters there are blind, so when
guests are ready to leave, they call the waiter's name. Their waiter then
takes them back to the place where they ordered the food. There are
additional restaurants in London and Moscow. DQ bhikes
